newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks leap 1,500-point barrier at close.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks leap 1,500-point barrier at close.

text.p: Pakistani stocks soared over the 1,500-point barrier to close 2.83 percent higher on Monday on blue-chip buying prompted by a rise in synthetic fibre prices and some good corporate results, dealers said.
"People were bullish in synthetic and energy stocks, but most buying remained speculative," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. "After today's sharp rise, we expect near-term profit-taking."
The Karachi 100-share index rose 41.31 points, to end at 1,500.47. Gainers led losers 142 to 86. Pak State Oil rose 33 rupees to 380 and Dewan Salman Fibres 3.0 to 38.40.
